title: Shift photocurrent vortices from topological polarization textures
verdict_detail: Reduced 2-band k.p model reproduces the essential MECHANISM: quantized meron/antimeron polarization texture, a co-located real-space VORTEX in the shift-photoconductivity vector sigma(r), and (anti)parallel sigma-P locking (parallel in the lower resonance window, antiparallel in the upper window matching the paper's omega_M fingerprint). 4/4 reduced-model checks pass. NOT reproduced: full four-band SU(4) moire model, DFT, quantitative omega_M~6eV spectrum, tensor components per stacking.
model: reduced 2-band d.sigma over config-space meron texture (NOT full four-band SU(4))
compute: CPU-only, numpy/scipy/matplotlib, ~1.5s runtime, no paid APIs
